question:
If M denotes ‘−’, N denotes ‘÷’, O denotes ‘×’ and P denotes ‘+’, then what will come in place of ‘?’ in the following equation

(16 O 7) P 124 M 92 P (86 N 43) O 18 M 29 = ?
solution:
From the given information:

M denotes ‘−’, N denotes ‘÷’, O denotes ‘×’ and P denotes ‘+’We substitute the values and solve the equation using BODMAS rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13bc0065c96e715682af7c8a6dc1b4c567b7a2a89597cc68809a5ff942c7e421.png] 

**(16 O 7) P 124 M 92 P (86 N 43) O 18 M 29 = ?**

(__**16 × 7**__) + 124 - 92 + (__**86 ÷ 43**__) × 18 - 29 = ?

112 + 124 - 92 + __**2 × 18**__ - 29 = ?

__**112 + 124**__ - 92 __**+ 36**__ - 29 = ?

__**272 - 92 - 29**__ = ? 

151 = Answer

Hence **the correct answer is option 2)**
